verdict.rationale: cfo.ai's assistant Ari is driven by natural-language requests. Users ask it questions such as whether they can afford to hire, request scenarios in one line, trigger syncs, add tables and rebuild workbooks by asking. External agents connected over MCP can also be told in plain language to update forecasts or build tables. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation, and evidence that every product function (e.g., sharing links, Excel export) can be driven by natural language.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Ask it whether you can afford to hire, why spending went up, or how long your cash lasts.
Scenarios you ask for in one line: a hire wave, a slipped quarter, a downside growth case, several at once.
Sync QuickBooks or another connected source now with Sync now or by asking Ari, stop a running sync
ask Ari to add or remove tables later, such as syncing one more table from Postgres
Have Ari rebuild your workbook as a live Model, then check that it ties.
ask Claude to update this month's forecast, or have Codex build a table.
